title: 第七章 夏暮妹妹最近是不是谈男朋友了
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

薄璟琛停下脚步，回头望了夏暮一眼。

她的脸，看起来没什么血色。

那双平日里怯怯的眼神，此时直视着他，不闪不避。

他单手捂拳，放在唇边，不自然地轻咳一声。

“我让你解除婚约，不是让你用来，逃避陪我体检的责任的。”

夏暮活生生被他的理直气壮气笑了，“薄璟琛，我很忙，明天还要上班，真的没空再跟你玩这套大少爷的游戏了。”

薄璟琛从裤袋里抽出手。

单手理了理凌乱的袖口，动作优雅。

等了很久，才挑眉冷眼回望她，“夏暮，别忘了你的身份。”

薄璟琛的话，宛如一盆冬日里的冰水，迎面浇下。

刺骨的寒意从脚尖蔓延到了后颈，又停在脑海，仿佛把她的所有难堪都剖开，赤裸裸地展露在外。

她的身份。

薄家养女，薄璟琛的童养媳？

还是......一直毫无尊严，跟在他身后，爱得失去了自我的那个夏暮。

夏暮瞳孔里的温度，随之，一点一点散去。

不论是什么身份，她全都不想要了。

指节在身侧，死死捏成拳，才能强行压下抑制不住的轻颤。

好在，许卿适时地从一旁的ct室推门出来，打破了这场僵持的对峙。

“都来了？进来吧。”

穿着白大褂，手里拿着一沓刚打印出来片子的许卿看了眼腕表，随意催促道。

话音落下，他的目光，随意地在夏暮脸上停了一瞬。

眼神带着点若有所思的打量。

夏暮注意到了。

不用想也知道，肯定是因为那通电话......他听见了霍宴年的声音。

但看今天薄璟琛的情况，以及刚才许卿的那个眼神。

她可以断定，他并没有把这件事告诉别人。

夏暮朝他友善地点了点头，退后一步，靠在走廊的墙上，示意自己就不进去了，在外面等。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Bo Jingchen stopped and looked back at Xia Mu.

Her face looked pale.

Those usually timid eyes were looking directly at him without evading him.

He cupped his fist with one hand, put it to his lips, and coughed unnaturally.

"I asked you to terminate the engagement, not for you to evade your responsibility to accompany me for a medical examination."

Xia Mu laughed at his confidence, "Bo Jingchen, I'm very busy and have to go to work tomorrow. I really don't have time to play this young master's game with you anymore."

Bo Jingchen took his hand out of his trouser pocket.

He straightened the messy cuffs with one hand and moved gracefully.

After waiting for a long time, he raised his eyebrows and looked back at her coldly, "Xia Mu, don't forget your identity."

Bo Jingchen's words were like a basin of ice water pouring down on her face in winter.

The biting chill spread from her toes to the back of her neck, and then stopped in her mind, as if all her embarrassments had been cut open and exposed nakedly.

her identity.

The adopted daughter of the Bo family, the child bride of Bo Jingchen?

Or... the Xia Mu who had always followed him without any dignity and lost herself in love.

The temperature in Xia Mu's pupils then dissipated little by little.

No matter what her identity was, she didn't want any of them.

With his knuckles at his side and tightly clenched into a fist, he could suppress the uncontrollable trembling.

Fortunately, Xu Qing pushed the door out of the CT room at the right time, breaking the deadlock.

"Are you all here? Come in."

Xu Qing, who was wearing a white coat and holding a stack of newly printed films in his hand, glanced at his watch and urged casually.

After he finished speaking, his gaze casually paused on Xia Mu's face for a moment.

His eyes looked thoughtfully.

Xia Mu noticed.

Without thinking, he knew that it must be because of that phone call... He heard Huo Yannian's voice.

But look at Bo Jingchen's situation today and the look in Xu Qing's eyes just now.

She could tell that he hadn't told anyone else about it.

Xia Mu nodded kindly to him, took a step back, leaned against the wall of the corridor, and signaled that she would not go in and wait outside.
